latin: Secunda est quod peccato mortali finiti temporis non debetur pena infinita secundum tempus, sed finita tantum.

mentions.context: (4>8) Wrong, erroneous, heretical. 2. The second is: that for a mortal sin of a ﬁnite time an inﬁnite temporal penalty is not due, but only a ﬁnite penalty. (4>20) Wrong, erroneous, heretical. 3. Neither the Cross of Christ, nor any image, should be adored with the adoration of veneration, even in that way that Thomas proposes.
